headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC welcomes NFRA announcement supporting mainland insurers to invest in Hong Kong ETFs via Stock Connect
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data August 18 - The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission welcomes the National Financial Regulatory Administration's announcement today that it will actively support the participation of mainland insurance funds in the connectivity between mainland and Hong Kong financial markets, and support mainland insurance institutions to invest in ETFs listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange via the Shanghai-Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect. This policy will further enrich the options for mainland insurance institutions to make offshore asset allocations via Hong Kong, reflecting the NFRA's support for continuously deepening financial connectivity between the mainland and Hong Kong. Dr. Huang Tianzhu, Chairman of the SFC, said: 'We sincerely thank the NFRA for its long-standing firm support for the development of Hong Kong's capital market and the financial connectivity between the mainland and Hong Kong. This new policy broadens diversified channels for mainland insurance funds to allocate offshore assets, demonstrating the nation's determination to deepen high-level financial opening-up, and also reflecting the central government's support for continuously deepening financial cooperation between the two places. headlines.summary: 今年以来，中国进出口银行充分发挥政策性金融职能作用，加大资源倾斜力度，全力支持制造业高质量发展，助力构建以先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系。今年1—7月，中国进出口银行新发放制造业贷款近5000亿元，重点支持了传统产业转型升级、新兴产业发展壮大、未来产业提前布局等领域，其中先进制造业贷款近2000亿元，占比40%。 (央视新闻)

headlines.title_en: China Exim Bank issued nearly RMB 500 billion in new manufacturing loans in first seven months
headlines.summary_en: Since the beginning of this year, the Export-Import Bank of China has fully leveraged its role as a policy-oriented financial institution, increasing resource allocation to fully support the high-quality development of the manufacturing industry and help build a modern industrial system led by advanced manufacturing. From January to July this year, the Export-Import Bank of China issued nearly 500 billion yuan in new manufacturing loans, focusing on supporting areas such as the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, the growth of emerging industries, and the early layout of future industries, of which advanced manufacturing loans were nearly 200 billion yuan, accounting for 40%. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: State Council: housing provident fund deposit and lending rates are determined by the State Council
headlines.summary_en: The State Council issued a decision to amend the 'Regulations on the Administration of Housing Provident Funds'. The amendments include changing Article 6 to: 'The deposit and loan interest rates of housing provident funds shall be determined by the State Council.' In the first paragraph of Article 28, 'may use housing provident funds to purchase government bonds' is amended to 'may use housing provident funds to purchase government bonds and policy-oriented financial bonds.'

headlines.summary_en: China Unicom announced that revenue for the first half of 2026 was 20.136 billion yuan, up 0.6% year-on-year. headlines.title_en: China Unicom (H-shares): H1 2026 revenue RMB 201.4 billion; computing power revenue RMB 41.9 billion, up 13% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: China Unicom announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange: Revenue in the first half of 2026 was stable, with operating revenue of RMB 201.4 billion, up 0.6% year-on-year, despite challenges facing overall industry growth; affected by changes in the pace of value-added tax and labor cost investments, profitability faced short-term pressure, but the full-year profit decline is expected to narrow significantly. Net profit for the first half of 2026 was RMB 9.5 billion, down 34.6% year-on-year. Computing power revenue was RMB 41.9 billion, up 13% year-on-year, of which intelligent computing center revenue increased 11% year-on-year and intelligent computing revenue increased 9% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 国家金融监督管理总局副局长肖远企会见香港特区政府财经事务及库务局局长许正宇

headlines.title_en: NFRA Vice Chairman Xiao Yuanqi meets Hong Kong SAR Financial Services and Treasury Secretary Christopher Hui
headlines.summary_en: On August 18, Xiao Yuanqi, member of the Party Committee and Deputy Director of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, met with a delegation led by Christopher Hui, Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury of the Hong Kong SAR Government. The two sides exchanged views on topics such as the latest developments in the financial industries of the two places and supporting Hong Kong in consolidating and enhancing its status as an international financial center. Xiao Yuanqi stated that the NFRA supports the participation of mainland insurance funds in the connectivity between mainland and Hong Kong financial markets, and supports mainland insurance institutions to invest in ETFs listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange via the Shanghai-Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect.

headlines.title_en: Ping An Good Doctor H1 net profit RMB 219.3 million, versus RMB 134.2 million in the same period last year
headlines.summary_en: Ping An Good Doctor's net profit for the first half of the year was RMB 219.3 million, compared with RMB 134.2 million in the same period last year. Revenue for the first half of the year was RMB 2.48 billion, down 0.7% year-on-year. Adjusted net profit for the first half was RMB 226.8 million, up 38% year-on-year. Gross profit for the first half was RMB 956.7 million, up 14% year-on-year. Gross margin for the first half was 38.5%.

headlines.title_en: Bakeve Micro: H1 2026 net profit between RMB 100.3 million and RMB 108.01 million, up about 30%-40% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Bakewei (02149.HK) announced that for the six months ended June 30, 2026, it recorded revenue ranging from RMB 321 million to RMB 336 million, up approximately 10% to 15% year-on-year; and net profit ranging from RMB 100.3 million to RMB 108 million, up approximately 30% to 40% year-on-year. The expected revenue and net profit growth for the reporting period is mainly due to the continued growth in replacement demand for high-end analog chips. Leveraging its long-accumulated high-quality industrial product portfolio, the company continues to serve core customers in the broad industrial field. With the steady expansion of product categories, the company's market share in the high-end industrial analog chip field has steadily increased; and thanks to its machine learning-based semi-automated chip design methodology, its self-developed R&D platform continues to unleash cost advantages and efficiency benefits in the design phase. headlines.title: 群核科技增资至16.91亿
headlines.summary: 天眼查App显示，近日，杭州群核信息技术有限公司发生工商变更，注册资本由约14.91亿人民币增至约16.91亿人民币。杭州群核信息技术有限公司成立于2011年11月，法定代表人为黄晓煌，经营范围包括信息技术咨询服务、货物进出口、技术进出口、技术服务、技术开发、技术咨询、技术交流、技术转让、技术推广等。

headlines.title_en: Qunhe Technology increases registered capital to RMB 1.691 billion
headlines.summary_en: Tianyancha App shows that recently, Hangzhou Qunhe Information Technology Co., Ltd. underwent an industrial and commercial change, with registered capital increasing from approximately RMB 1.491 billion to approximately RMB 1.691 billion. Hangzhou Qunhe Information Technology Co., Ltd. was established in November 2011, with legal representative Huang Xiaohuang, and its business scope includes information technology consulting services, import and export of goods, import and export of technology, technical services, technology development, technical consulting, technical exchange, technology transfer, and technology promotion.
